claim_boundary: This is an import proposal only.
It does not import the disabled source adapter into the active app.
It requires explicit approval before source code can import the adapter.
It performs no live app action.
It does not call a model.
It does not use the network.
It does not write durable memory.
It does not change routes, deploy assets, or gateway behavior.
It does not execute arbitrary generated UI.
blocked_claims: Source adapter import is live in the public app.
Source adapter import called a model.
Source adapter import used the network.
Source adapter import wrote durable memory.
Source adapter import changed app routes.
Source adapter import changed gateway behavior.
Source adapter import deployed public assets.
Source adapter import executed arbitrary generated UI.
